scripts.dev: pnpm cloudflare:sync && uv run --locked --package hotkey-tools-python env UV_NO_EDITABLE=1 pywrangler dev
scripts.lint: uv run --locked --package hotkey-tools-python ruff check src tests && uv run --locked --package hotkey-tools-python ruff format --check src tests
scripts.format: uv run --locked --package hotkey-tools-python ruff format src tests
scripts.cloudflare:sync: uv run --locked --package hotkey-tools-python env UV_NO_EDITABLE=1 pywrangler sync --force
scripts.deploy: pnpm cloudflare:sync && uv run --locked --package hotkey-tools-python env UV_NO_EDITABLE=1 pywrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm cloudflare:sync && uv run --locked --package hotkey-tools-python env UV_NO_EDITABLE=1 pywrangler deploy --dry-run
